requirements.requirement: The system must include a pi_credibility object in each clinical trial response returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate pi_credibility.investigator_name from upstream PI logic output.
The system must populate pi_credibility.affiliated_institution when available from upstream data.
The system must include pi_credibility.prior_trials_count as an integer field in the API response.
The system must include pi_credibility.completed_trials_count as an integer field in the API response.
The system must include pi_credibility.publications_count as an integer field in the API response.
The system must include pi_credibility.fda_approval_count as an integer field in the API response.
The system must include pi_credibility.prior_trial_outcomes_summary as a string field in the API response.
The system must include pi_credibility.composite_credibility_score as a numeric field for each trial.
The system must ensure the composite_credibility_score is within a normalized range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must attach PI credibility data to the correct clinical trial using a consistent identifier mapping from upstream logic.
The system must gracefully return a null or empty pi_credibility object when no investigator data is available for a trial.
The system must not fail the entire clinical trials response if PI credibility data is missing for one or more trials.
The system must return all non-PI clinical trial data unchanged when PI credibility enrichment is applied.
The system must call the PI credibility logic layer exactly once per unique investigator per request to avoid redundant computation.
The system must handle upstream PI logic failures by returning pi_credibility with a status indicator of unavailable.
The system must ensure API response latency does not exceed existing evaluate_care_facade latency thresholds by more than 20% after PI enrichment.
The system must expose PI credibility fields in a deterministic schema consistent with the Pydantic model defined in EVAL-CT-PI-SCHEMA-001.
The system must ensure no personally sensitive data beyond professional credentials is included in the PI credibility object.
The system must generate a concise, user-facing textual summary of PI credibility for each trial when requested by downstream consumers.
The system must ensure the textual summary of PI credibility accurately reflects the underlying structured fields without contradiction.
The system must avoid hallucinating PI attributes not present in upstream data when generating any LLM-based summary.
